title: gUFO — lightweight OWL implementation of UFO
scope: Foundational categories and relations implementing selected UFO semantics
overlap_with_cm4di: Kinds/categories, roles, relators, events, situations, participation and foundational projection
import_policy: Selective foundational alignment/import after #69 projection decision; do not duplicate foundational semantics

title: ONTrust Reference Ontology of Trust
overlap_with_cm4di: Trust relation/assessment and related foundational distinctions
import_policy: Prefer explicit trust alignment over redefining a complete general trust ontology inside CM4DI

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
scope: Provenance of entities, activities and agents
overlap_with_cm4di: Evidence/claim/credential provenance, source derivation and attribution
import_policy: Reuse/align provenance patterns where they fit; CM4DI retains identity-specific evidence semantics

title: The Organization Ontology
scope: Organizations, organizational units, membership, roles and sites
import_policy: Do not recreate generic organizational structure; map only identity-governance roles/participation needed by CM4DI

title: ODRL Information Model 2.2
scope: Policies, permissions, prohibitions, duties, assets, parties and actions
import_policy: Keep CM4DI minimal authorization kernel; map richer policy semantics to ODRL rather than absorb full policy language

title: Data Privacy Vocabulary v2
owner_or_authors: W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group
scope: Personal-data processing, purposes, legal bases, roles, rights, risk and compliance
overlap_with_cm4di: Identity information processing, consent/privacy boundary, legal bases and governance
import_policy: Privacy/data-processing semantics remain outside CM4DI Core; use mappings/bridges where identity scenarios need them

title: W3C Verifiable Credentials RDF vocabulary/model
overlap_with_cm4di: Credential, Claim, Issuer, Holder, Verifier, status and presentation semantics
import_policy: Preserve CM4DI neutral credential semantics; map VC-specific constructs precisely and import only when stable semantic reuse is beneficial
